title: The lab results rules version is a hand-kept Swift constant, not the engine's
evidence: Root fix R16 (triage 2026-11-25): the phone reads its constants and rules from the engine. ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/HealthSyncMemory.swift:44 labResultsRulesVersion = 3, read at AppleHealthSync.swift:328-330; bumped by hand when the engine's lab-result rules change (US-72). Should come from the engine. Found during shared upload PR 1, 2026-11-11
